title: Austin Approves Election Judges Ordinance
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   Austin City leaders held a brief special meeting.
*   The main action was the unanimous approval of an emergency ordinance.
*   This ordinance added exhibits related to additional election day judges and operational procedures.
